capabilities: Copy notes to clipboard as rich HTML.
Render mathematical formulas as MathML or KaTeX.
Format code blocks for external document compatibility.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that copies notes or text selections to your system clipboard as rich HTML, with mathematical formulas rendered as native MathML or KaTeX representations for seamless pasting into Microsoft Word, Google Docs, Apple Pages, LibreOffice, Gmail, and Anki.
problem: Standard copy methods leave mathematical formulas as raw LaTeX text or cause duplication issues when pasting content from AI tools into other applications.

relations.evidence: Based on the original obsidian-copy-as-html by mvdkwast.

summary: A plugin that copies notes or selections to the clipboard as rich HTML, rendering mathematical formulas as MathML or KaTeX for seamless pasting into various applications.
